cases.explain: Свидригайлов is the grammatical subject of тревожил (troubled), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: было что-то тяжелое и мистически ужасное, с самого ___.
cases.translation: There had always been something heavy and mystically terrible about it, since childhood.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'since/from' governs the genitive case here.

cases.translation: After the service, Raskolnikov went up to Sonya.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Raskolnikov shook her hand and went out.
cases.explain: Руку is the direct object of the transitive verb пожал (shook/pressed), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: он ел и пил с большим ___, чуть не с жадностью.
cases.translation: He ate and drank with a great appetite, almost greedily.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: находя себя где-нибудь в каком-нибудь жалком ___ одного, за столом.
cases.translation: Finding himself somewhere in some wretched tavern, alone, at a table.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Для Раскольникова наступило странное время

options: A strange time, as if fog had cut him off in isolation
A time of joy and relief

reading.explain: The text says 'Для Раскольникова наступило странное время: точно туман упал вдруг перед ним.'

reading.correct: Svidrigailov

reading.ru: Полечка плакала.
reading.question: What was Polechka doing at the memorial service?
reading.correct: Crying

reading.ru: Раскольников отстоял всю службу.

options: Yes, he stood through the whole service
reading.correct: Yes, he stood through the whole service

reading.ru: Та вдруг взяла его за обе руки и преклонила к его плечу голову.

Indifferent, he had forgotten about it

reading.ru: А! ест, стало быть, не болен!

reading.ru: Мать больна со вчерашнего дня серьезно.

options: She has been seriously ill since yesterday
reading.correct: She has been seriously ill since yesterday
